title: R24 TABLESTYLE indexed color transport

source.specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §§20.4.101.3–.4
source.finding: Content and cell-style color fields use TC values. The existing DXF writer serializes indexed colors as group 62; indexed CMC profiles use the documented canonical indexed-color method.

implementation.behavior: The AC1024 TABLESTYLE writer admits representable indexed colors 0–255, including the existing ByBlock form, and the existing ByNone background form. RGB/book-color profiles remain refused because this writer emits scalar group 62 values only.

validation.result: Build passed; focused CTest passed 1/1. Generated ASCII/Binary controls verify indexed background/content/border colors at exact field positions, typed/raw readback, out-of-range color refusal with destination preservation, and same-adapter retry.

qualificationLimits: Only indexed scalar colors are admitted; truecolor and book-color CMC values are not represented by this writer route.
Generated codec controls do not qualify independent producer wire behavior or native rendering.
No whole-file DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
